2020

When physical gatherings stopped, access to learning didn't have to.

Empowered Vessels for Change Initiative · Founder & President, Programme Lead

205+participants reached
2days of training
4learning areas
View case study

The challenge

COVID-19 lockdown had closed every training room. People wanted to stay productive and pick up useful skills, with nowhere to go to do it.

My role

I led the programme end to end as founder of EVCI.

What I did

  • Planned and delivered a free two-day online training
  • Engaged and coordinated experienced facilitators
  • Used WhatsApp so participants in different locations could join
  • Supported participant communication and participation
  • Organised sessions on Digital Marketing, Artificial Intelligence, Content Writing and Online Media
  • Supported completion and certificate distribution

Outcome

Over 205 participants joined from multiple locations across Nigeria, each leaving with a certificate. The programme drew national press coverage.

How I work

Six habits that keep work finished.

  1. Understand the objective. Before the task list, the point of it.
  2. Name priorities and owners. Everyone knows what is theirs.
  3. Connect people, information and resources. Nothing waits on a missing handover.
  4. Keep records tidy. Communication and documents stay findable.
  5. Follow through. Open tasks get chased until they close.
  6. Review. One last look for the detail that would otherwise slip.
